props.note: Poseidon, the tallest carbonate spire in the field: about 60 m tall (Wikipedia, 'Lost City Hydrothermal Field'). Wikipedia also gives '100 metres wide', which describes the whole multi-spire edifice rather than one column; dimensions_m[0]=70 is an estimate for a single tapered tower's base. Placed at the corrected field location (see pois.json note); exact position within the ~500 sq m field is not published and the GMRT grid (~53 x 61 m/cell) cannot resolve it. Colour: material_hint carbonate renders the pale white/cream carbonate-brucite of Lost City's towers. See sources.md.
'Beehive' is a real named structure in the field (Wikipedia). No published height or coordinate; 12 m and this position are estimates, placed near Poseidon within the sourced depth band.
'IMAX Tower', named for the IMAX documentary crew that filmed it; height ~8 m (Wikipedia, 'Lost City Hydrothermal Field'). No published coordinate; placed near Poseidon within the sourced depth band.

Illustrative minor chimney; the field has dozens of spires and flanges of varying size (Kelley et al. 2005 describe a dense cluster), most unnamed and unmapped individually. Height and position are invented.
Illustrative minor chimney (see unnamed-chimney-1). Height and position are invented.
